question: What is the inner desire to emit within the great Lord called?
premises: From the great Lord arises another principle in the same way.
Within him there is an inner desire to emit.
That desire is declared to be the supreme Kauliki power.
inference: The Lord's inner impulse to emanate is identified as the supreme Kauliki power.
uncertainties: The sandhi form so@nyo is read as saḥ anyaḥ.
plain_english: In the same way, from the great Lord arises another principle. Even while appearing as a vowel in two ways, that inner desire to emit within him is declared to be the supreme Kauliki power.
